topic.label: Crypto and Digital Assets
topic.desc: Crypto and Digital Assets: Blockchains and Consensus, Crypto Exchanges and DeFi, Crypto Regulation and Tax, Stablecoins and Central Bank Digital Currencies, Cryptocurrencies and Tokens and Wallets and Custody.

concepts.label: Blockchains and Consensus
concepts.desc: How blockchains work: blocks, consensus (proof of work, proof of stake), nodes and smart contracts.

concepts.label: Wallets and Custody
concepts.desc: Wallets, private keys, seed phrases, self custody versus custodians, and security.

concepts.label: Crypto Exchanges and DeFi
concepts.desc: Centralized exchanges, decentralized exchanges, liquidity pools, lending and their risks.

concepts.label: Stablecoins and Central Bank Digital Currencies
concepts.desc: Fiat-backed and algorithmic stablecoins, reserves, and central bank digital currencies.

concepts.label: Crypto Regulation and Tax
concepts.desc: How crypto is regulated and taxed by jurisdiction: securities status, licensing, travel rule and reporting.

concepts.label: Cryptocurrencies and Tokens
concepts.desc: Bitcoin, Ether, tokens, token standards, supply schedules and tokenomics.

skills.label: Blockchain Explainer
skills.desc: Explains how a blockchain records and confirms transactions and its trust assumptions.

skills.label: Custody Option Comparator
skills.desc: Compares self custody, hardware wallets and custodians by risk and control.

skills.label: DeFi Risk Reviewer
skills.desc: Reviews a DeFi protocol's smart contract, liquidity and counterparty risks.

skills.label: Stablecoin Reserve Checker
skills.desc: Explains a stablecoin's peg mechanism and how its reserves are attested.

skills.label: Crypto Regulatory Map
skills.desc: Maps how a crypto activity is regulated in a jurisdiction and what must be reported.

skills.label: Token Analyzer
skills.desc: Analyzes a token's supply, distribution, utility and risks.

mcp.name: CCXT MCP
mcp.desc: CCXT MCP server: cryptocurrency exchange market data, tickers, order books, trades and accounts across many crypto exchanges.

mcp.name: Coinbase AgentKit
mcp.desc: Coinbase AgentKit: onchain wallets, token transfers, swaps and smart contract actions on crypto blockchains, with an MCP extension.
